```{r}
library(InfoTrad)
library(lubridate)
library(ISOweek)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r cars}
rm(df)
df = read.csv('data/OUT/Pos+quotes+volume+spread.csv')
df = df[!(duplicated(df$isin) & duplicated(df$close)), ]
rm(data)
rm(df_f)

ISIN = 'LKOH'


df_f = subset(df, isin == ISIN)
data=cbind(df_f$moment,df_f$isin,(df_f$close-df_f$X.SPREAD./2),(df_f$close+df_f$X.SPREAD./2))
colnames(data) = c('moment','isin',"Buy", "Sell")

Buy = as.double(data[,'Buy'])
Sell = as.double(data[,'Sell'])
sample=cbind(Buy,Sell)
```

Расчет по окнам в торговую неделю

```{r}
res_pin = data.frame(week_start = character(0), week_ends = character(0), pin = character(0))

for (i in 1:51){
  
try({week_number = week(data[,1])
  specific_week_data = data[week_number == i, ]
  
  Buy = as.double(specific_week_data[,'Buy'])
  Sell = as.double(specific_week_data[,'Sell'])
  sample_week=cbind(Buy,Sell)
  
  result=YZ(sample_week)
  
  res_pin[(nrow(res_pin) + 1),] = (c(specific_week_data[1][1],specific_week_data[nrow(specific_week_data)][1],result$PIN))
})

}

```

```{r}
names(res_pin)[names(res_pin) == 'week_start'] = 'moment'
merged_df = merge(df_f, res_pin, by = "moment", all.x = TRUE)
merged_df = fill(merged_df,week_ends,pin)
```

# Построение графика с двумя линиями

```{r}

y1 = as.numeric(merged_df$long_position_fiz)
y2 = as.numeric(merged_df$close)
x = as.Date(merged_df$moment)

# Создание графика с основной линией по левой шкале
plot(x, y1, type = "l", col = "blue", xlab = "Даты", ylab = "long_position")

# Добавление второй линии по правой шкале
par(new = TRUE)
plot(x, y2, type = "l", col = "red", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
axis(side = 4)
mtext(side = 4, line = 3, "Значения 2", col = "red")

# Добавление легенды
legend("topleft", legend = c("long_position", "close"), col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1)

# Добавление заголовка
title(main = "График двух линий с датами и двумя шкалами")
```

```{r}
y1 = as.numeric(merged_df$long_position_fiz)
y2 = as.numeric(merged_df$close)
x = as.Date(merged_df$moment)

z1 = as.numeric(merged_df$pin)
z2 = as.numeric(merged_df$X.SPREAD.)

options(repr.plot.inline = FALSE)

par(mar = c(1,1, 1, 1))

par(pin = c(5, 2))

# Установка параметра mfrow для создания двух графиков один под другим
par(mfrow = c(2, 1))

# Первый график
plot(x, y1, type = "l", col = "blue", xlab = "Даты", ylab = "long_position")

# Добавление второй линии по правой шкале
par(new = TRUE)
plot(x, y2, type = "l", col = "red", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
axis(side = 4)
mtext(side = 4, line = 3, ISIN, col = "red")
legend("topleft", legend = c("long_position", "close_price"), col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1)


# Второй график
plot(x, z1, type = "l", col = "red", xlab = "Даты", ylab = "Значения 2a", ylim = c(0,1))
lines(x, z2, col = "orange")
legend("topleft", legend = c("PIN", "SPREAD"), col = c("red", "orange"), lty = 1)

```

```{r}
rm(df)
df = read.csv('data/OUT/Pos+quotes+volume+spread.csv')
df = df[!(duplicated(df$isin) & duplicated(df$close)), ]

ISIN = 'AFKS'

rm(data)
rm(df_f)

df_f = subset(df, isin == ISIN)
data=cbind(df_f$moment,df_f$isin,(df_f$close-df_f$X.SPREAD./2),(df_f$close+df_f$X.SPREAD./2))
colnames(data) = c('moment','isin',"Buy", "Sell")

Buy = as.double(data[,'Buy'])
Sell = as.double(data[,'Sell'])
sample=cbind(Buy,Sell)

res_pin = data.frame(week_start = character(0), week_ends = character(0), pin = character(0))

#loop for weekly pin

for (i in 1:51){
  
try({week_number = week(data[,1])
  specific_week_data = data[week_number == i, ]
  
  Buy = as.double(specific_week_data[,'Buy'])
  Sell = as.double(specific_week_data[,'Sell'])
  sample_week=cbind(Buy,Sell)
  
  result=YZ(sample_week)
  
  res_pin[(nrow(res_pin) + 1),] = (c(specific_week_data[1][1],specific_week_data[nrow(specific_week_data)][1],result$PIN))
})

}

names(res_pin)[names(res_pin) == 'week_start'] = 'moment'
merged_df = merge(df_f, res_pin, by = "moment", all.x = TRUE)
merged_df = fill(merged_df,week_ends,pin)

png("my_plot.png", width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)

#Graphs

y1 = as.numeric(merged_df$long_position_fiz)
y2 = as.numeric(merged_df$close)
x = as.Date(merged_df$moment)

z1 = as.numeric(merged_df$pin)
z2 = as.numeric(merged_df$X.SPREAD.)

options(repr.plot.inline = FALSE)

par(pin = c(5, 2))

# Установка параметра mfrow для создания двух графиков один под другим
par(mfrow = c(2, 1))

# Первый график
plot(x, y1, type = "l", col = "blue", xlab = "Даты", ylab = "long_position")

# Добавление второй линии по правой шкале
par(new = TRUE)
plot(x, y2, type = "l", col = "red", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
axis(side = 4)
mtext(side = 4, line = 3, "Значения 2", col = "red")
legend("topleft", legend = c("long_position", "close_price"), col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1)


# Второй график
plot(x, z1, type = "l", col = "red", xlab = "Даты", ylab = "Значения 2a", ylim = c(0,1))
lines(x, z2, col = "orange")
legend("topleft", legend = c("PIN", "SPREAD"), col = c("red", "orange"), lty = 1)

dev.off
```

```{r}
rm(df)
rm(merged_df)

df = read.csv('data/OUT/Pos+quotes+volume+spread.csv')
df = df[!(duplicated(df$isin) & duplicated(df$close)), ]

ISIN = 'AFKS'

rm(data)
rm(df_f)

df_f = subset(df, isin == ISIN)
df_f$X.SPREAD.=df_f$X.SPREAD.*100
data=cbind(df_f$moment,df_f$isin,(df_f$close-df_f$X.SPREAD./2),(df_f$close+df_f$X.SPREAD./2))
colnames(data) = c('moment','isin',"Buy", "Sell")

Buy = as.double(data[,'Buy'])
Sell = as.double(data[,'Sell'])
sample=cbind(Buy,Sell)

res_pin = data.frame(week_start = character(0), week_ends = character(0), pin = character(0))

for (i in 1:51){
  
try({week_number = week(data[,1])
  specific_week_data = data[week_number == i, ]
  
  Buy = as.double(specific_week_data[,'Buy'])
  Sell = as.double(specific_week_data[,'Sell'])
  sample_week=cbind(Buy,Sell)
  
  result=YZ(sample_week)
  
  res_pin[(nrow(res_pin) + 1),] = (c(specific_week_data[1][1],specific_week_data[nrow(specific_week_data)][1],result$PIN))
})

}

names(res_pin)[names(res_pin) == 'week_start'] = 'moment'
merged_df = merge(df_f, res_pin, by = "moment", all.x = TRUE)
merged_df = fill(merged_df,week_ends,pin)
```
